name: Baofeng AR-5 Helper
author: Raymond Thurman
description: Bar widget helper for Baofeng AR-5 / UV-5R-class radios: channel lists, NOAA weather, simplex/calling references, CHIRP launch, CSV import/export, and a programming safety checklist. Never auto-uploads to the radio.

schema.label: CHIRP command
schema.description: Executable used to launch CHIRP (default: chirp).

schema.label: CHIRP radio model
schema.description: CHIRP model id for this radio (default: 5RM).

schema.label: Show NOAA tab
schema.description: Include NOAA weather frequencies in the panel.

schema.label: Data directory
schema.description: Folder for channels JSON, checklist, and timestamps.
